If <math><mi mathvariant="normal">M</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">K</mi></math> is another point on the line <math><msub><mrow><mi>l</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub></math> (other than <math><mi mathvariant="normal">D</mi></math>), then the locus of the point of intersection of <math><msub><mrow><mi>l</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math> and angle bisector of the angle <math><mi mathvariant="normal">M</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">D</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi></math> is a conic whose length of latus rectus rectum is equal to

solution.text:
Let the point of intersection of l2 and angle bisector of the angle MDS is Ph,k.

Draw perpendicular PF to l1 from P.

Now, ΔPFD and ΔPSD are congruent triangles.

Hence, PF=PS

⇒ locus of P is a parabola having S as focus and l1 as the directrix
Hence, the length of the latus rectum is 23+3-21+1=42 units
